meta.name: Public Disorder
meta.description: Following the fateful aftermath of a demonstration, tensions rise within a riot squad that struggles to separate work from personal life.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A demonstration ends violently. Tensions rise with the arrival of the riot squad's new leader and the protest's fallout.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Nobili tries to lead the team amid Mazinga's resistance, resulting in another injured agent. Investigations continue as someone questions loyalty.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The unit faces interrogation. Marta fears for her daughter. Nobili earns respect by defending a family during a riot — while a crisis erupts at home.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: While Nobili opens up to Marta, Mazinga expresses his exhaustion with work. Salvatore's long-distance relationship triggers his insecurities.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Still unsure about what to do with the new evidence, Nobili takes the law into his own hands — and so does Salvatore. Pietro gets serious with Mazinga.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: At a Christmas dinner, Nobili makes a final move to fit in with the squad. A notification from the prosecution puts everyone at risk of suspension.
